brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Three levels stacked: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:0,0,2;full with half-w side pieces at q1,0 on each level, capped and joint-bolted. 3 storeys vertical.
Three notch drawers installed: notch:0#0,1#notch1, notch:1#0,1#notch1, notch:2#0,1#notch1 (one per storey) with drawer frames/lids/runners in BOM.

finish.summary: Three-storey column (0,0 full hex x3 + 1,0 half-w supports) with one notch drawer per level = 3 drawers. Capped and locked, meshClash clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
